rules.title: Annual General Adjustment (AGA) Order for Year 2026, Rent Board Regulation 1148
rules.requirement: Eligible landlords may increase 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% no earlier than January 1, 2026. The AGA is set at 65% of the Bay Area CPI-U increase for July 1, 2024 to June 30, 2025, which was 1.5%. Landlords must meet the qualifying conditions and give tenants the required notice.
rules.citation: Berkeley Municipal Code section 13.76.110A; Rent Board Regulation 1148
rules.status_basis: Adopted October 16, 2025; rent ceilings may be increased no earlier than January 1, 2026.

requires.name: eligible_landlord
requires.text: allow eligible landlords to increase the 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0%

exempt_if.name: costa_hawkins_new_tenancy
exempt_if.text: The 2026 AGA may not adjust tenants' rents when their tenancy began on or after January 1, 2025, and who had their rents set pursuant to the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act.

coverage.summary: Applies to eligible landlords of rent-stabilized units in Berkeley.
coverage.exemptions_summary: Does not adjust rents for tenancies that began on or after January 1, 2025 with rents set under Costa-Hawkins.

rules.quoted_span:
At its regular meeting on October 16, 2025, the Berkeley Rent Stabilization Board 
adopted the Annual General Adjustment (AGA) Order for Year 2026 which will allow 
eligible landlords to increase the 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% no earlier than 
January 1, 2026.
